notes: kepler.gl demo app (examples/demo-app) built as a static production bundle (`yarn build`, esbuild) with node 24.21.0 + yarn 4.4.0 pinned in mise.toml. Rebuild: `bash .ui-capture/build.sh` (needs root + demo-app `yarn install` and `yarn bootstrap:prepare` first; during install a localhost registry relay, .ui-capture/registry-relay.mjs, was used because yarn's own proxy client stalled, and a few cached package zips had .idea/.vscode/.gitmodules entries stripped because the sandbox forbids writing them). Runtime config lives in out/config.json, read by the app's own src/utils/runtime-config.js. On boot the app loads /maps/norcal-seismic-ops.json via config.json `mapUrl` (the app's loadRemoteMap -> loadFiles path, kepler saved-map JSON format), generated by seed-map.py: 'NorCal seismic network — Q4 2026 ops review' with 3 datasets: the real NCSN earthquake catalogue (54,936 events 1967–2011, kepler.gl-data sample), a 176-station inventory (networks NC/BK/NP/CE/PG, statuses operational/degraded/offline/decommissioned/planned, install & maintenance dates, uptime, notes) and 268 field-service tickets (Jun 2025–Nov 2026, resolved/in progress/open/overdue/cancelled, P1–P4, technicians, summaries). Layers: earthquake points sized/colored by magnitude, hidden seismicity heatmap, stations colored by status, dispatch arcs from field offices to stations colored by priority. Filters: enlarged time-range playback bar on DateTime (1989–2011), magnitude range 2.8+, ticket status multi-select (open/in progress/overdue). Tooltips configured per dataset; dark-matter basemap. Verification: the production build succeeds and the seeded map parses cleanly through kepler's own KeplerGlSchema loader (validate-map.js / processKeplerglJSON: 3 datasets, 4 layers, 3 filters); headless Chromium could not be launched inside the build sandbox, so the rendered UI was not screenshot-checked. Main areas: left side panel (Layers, Filters, Interactions, Base map tabs; dataset list), map with tooltips/legend/map controls (split map, 3D, draw, legend, AI assistant toggle), bottom time-filter playback, Add Data modal (upload / URL / sample gallery with 11 local samples), Share/Export modals, data table viewer.
